name: vanilla-js-architect
description: Designs and implements browser-side SDKs, libraries, and frameworks in vanilla JavaScript. Architecture, encapsulation, distribution (ESM/UMD/IIFE), and cross-runtime support (browsers, Workers, Deno, Bun, Cloudflare Workers). Modern primitives: AbortSignal.any/timeout, Symbol.dispose/using, structuredClone. Ships .d.ts via JSDoc.
